title: Trace context
description: Correlation token carried inside the body of a trigger dispatch or an announcement. At least one of the two members must be present for a consumer to resolve it.

id.description: Id of a trace record that already exists. Wire key: id_ — the trailing underscore is on the wire.

trace-tag.description: Free-form label that opens a trace if no id is given. Not unique, and not an id despite the name of the constant that holds it. Wire key: trace_tag.
